profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Ethoca
profile.summary: I am an experienced software architect and engineer with strong project management skills who enjoys using Java, Spring, Angular, JIRA and many other tools along with interpersonal communication to succeed in projects.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using C# and C++, provided software for the survey and quality assurance teams that accomplished the following:

  » communication with geophysical survey equipment and plot the readings

  » extract and compress a section of survey data (which often starts as gigabytes of data) 
     into manageable chunks for easier transfer from survey site to headquarters

  » graphics, data management and data integrity components to display navigation data from 
     various sources to allow processing of the data in a consistent manner.

  » application to process data collected by Controlled Source Electro-Magnetic (CSEM) 
     equipment, which was used in all quality assurance activities.

  » development on an embedded system for LaCoste & Romberg's E-Meter gravity meter 
     using C++ and Windows CE.

  » user-interface, data management and terrain corrections on a joint development project 
     between Geotools and LaCoste & Romberg on GravMaster and GravModeler

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Using Java, C#, Visual Basic and C++, worked on the development of the following:

  » Integration of HotData web-services with legacy and third-party components.

  » Design of an object-oriented web product for assigning highly accurate tax rates for 
     integration into a customer's in-house software.

  » Designed and implemented components for the next generation, web-enabled 
     DataQuality server.

  » Implemented transfer of components of DataQuality.net product to Austin, Texas. This
     product, originally developed for Solaris, had been ported to the Windows NT system.

  » On design team for next generation DataQuality.net product for worldwide address 
     standardization.

  » Lead developer on HotData for Databases version 2.0.
